item.text:
Done. I added [proxy.ts](/vercel/sandbox/proxy.ts:1), which logs every matched request as `[request] <timestamp> <method> <path+query>` and then continues with `NextResponse.next()`. This uses Next 16’s root `proxy.ts` request hook. ([nextjs.org](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/api-reference/file-conventions/proxy))

Verified with `npm run build`, and a test `HEAD /` logged successfully. Dev server is running at `http://localhost:3000`.
